summary.text: Elizabeth Velasco, a Democrat, has represented District 57 in the Colorado House of Representatives since January 2023.

paragraphs.text: According to Ballotpedia, she advanced from the June 30, 2026 Democratic primary and is on the November 3, 2026 ballot for re-election.
Velasco's career includes owning a business and working as a public information officer.
